COMPRESS-253.label: I
COMPRESS-253.reason: This is a decompression bug, but in the BZip2 stream reader and truncated-input behavior. The current failure is in ZIP entry reading, specifically the first stored entry’s bytes coming back as NUL/incorrect data. Different archive format, different stream class, and different mechanism.

COMPRESS-259.label: P
COMPRESS-259.reason: This is in the same commons-compress stream-factory/decompression area, so it gives some regional signal about input-stream constructor/configuration handling. However, the mechanism is about propagating a `decompressConcatenated` flag in compressor factories, not ZIP stored-entry data extraction. Low-to-moderate utility only.

COMPRESS-261.label: I
COMPRESS-261.reason: This concerns 7z output configuration per entry, which is a different archive format and an output-side compression-setting issue. It shares only the broad archive package, with no meaningful overlap in the ZIP input parsing/read path causing the current NUL-byte failure.
